items.coder_A: LAT1 high expression, enrichment, matched qbs10072s (uncertain)
items.proposed: LAT1 high expression: enrichment, candidate_matched true (qbs10072s)
items.reason: The official title restricts the solid-tumour cohort to 'Advanced or Metastatic Cancers With High LAT1 Signatures' and the drug 'targets cancers with high LAT1 expression', so LAT1 is a cohort requirement linked to the candidate (enrichment). It is not in the eligibility list and the grade 4 astrocytoma cohort is not stated to require it, so it is not a whole-trial eligibility criterion.

The title names 'Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Grade 4 Astrocytoma' with no IDH requirement; under D27C (manual §1.1) this is the historical name for glioblastoma, named in the title, in a multi-cancer trial.

items.proposed: LAT1 high expression: enrichment (not whole-trial eligibility), candidate_matched true (qbs10072s)
items.reason: Same evidence as coder A's flag: LAT1 applies to the advanced/metastatic cohort only ('cancers with high LAT1 expression'), while 'The MTD of QBS10072S will be confirmed in patients with relapsed or refractory grade 4 astrocytoma' with no LAT1 condition.

The study is designed 'to determine the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics' of QBS10072S, a PD objective tied to the candidate, but no PD outcome is registered (outcomes are MTD, safety and plasma PK). Neither 'unclear' (W7: biomarker endpoint not linked to the candidate) nor 'no' (nothing planned) fits cleanly.

note: Primary outcome hinges on LAT1: it comes only from the title/summary, is not in the eligibility criteria, and applies to the non-GBM cohort, not to the grade 4 astrocytoma (GBM) cohort. Counting it makes candidate_matched_selection true for a trial whose GBM patients are not selected; XL may prefer to treat it as not an entry requirement (then candidate_matched_selection = false, any_molecular_selection = false). Glioblastoma is named only through 'Grade 4 Astrocytoma' (D27C) in the title. target_engagement convention as in NCT04982926.
